name: Air Force officer position benchmark scales
description: A set of benchmark scales devised to evaluate and rate officer performance and suitability for Air Force positions.
evaluation_method: human_eval / psychometric scoring using aggregated scale scores (sum/mean) and norm-referenced interpretation
general_score_metric: scale scores (sum/mean) and psychometric reliability/validity statistics (e.g., Cronbach's alpha)
reputation: Established instrument in military personnel assessment literature, used for Air Force officer evaluation and selection contexts.
notes: Not an ML/LLM benchmark; intended for human assessment. Contains sensitive personnel data and potential demographic biases; requires trained administrators and appropriate privacy safeguards.
